extracted.name: An Easy-as-Pie Sweet and Sour Sauce (no red sauce here...golden)
extracted.description: You’ll love this sweet and sour sauce recipe with no ketchup if you find the American version of this sauce a little too sweet and not sour enough.
instruction_lines: Stir together sugar, chicken broth, vinegar, oil, soy sauce, salt, and garlic in a medium saucepan until combined; bring to a boil.
Whisk together water and cornstarch in a small bowl until cornstarch is dissolved; whisk into boiling mixture. Cook sauce until thickened, 5 to 7 minutes.
